title: Yanayi da lokutan shekara
description: Ten short, simple stories about nature and the seasons in Hausaland: the first rain of the year in a village near Katsina, a flower garden in Jos, a flood in Kebbi, a cold harmattan night in Kano, experts at Lake Chad, pupils planting trees in Daura, a horse ride to a famous waterfall, a factory that spoils a river, old men playing cards in the Sokoto heat and a farmers' election before the rains.

lessons.title: Ruwan sama na farko
lessons.summary: In a village near Katsina everyone is waiting for the first rain; when the wind comes, little Zahra hides the chickens, and her father Halilu thanks God for the rain.
lessons.text:
Halilu yana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Katsina tare da matarsa da 'yarsa Zahra. Zahra yarinya ce mai shekara takwas. Halilu yana noma, amma a wannan shekara ruwan sama bai zo da wuri ba.

Kowace rana da safe, Halilu yakan fita ya duba sama. Dukan mutanen ƙauyen suna jiran ruwan sama. Gonaki sun bushe, kuma ƙasa tana da zafi sosai.

"Baba, yaushe ruwan sama zai zo?" Zahra ta ce.

"Ban sani ba," Halilu ya ce. "Muna jiransa kamar dukan mutanen ƙauye."

"Yaya za mu san ya kusa?" yarinyar ta ce.

"Za mu ji ƙarar iska da farko," babanta ya ce.

Wata rana da safe, Zahra tana ba kajinsu abinci a waje. Sai ta ji ƙarar iska mai ƙarfi. Rana ta ɓace. Kaji suka fara gudu nan da can.

"Baba! Iska ta zo!" Zahra ta ce.

Halilu ya fito. "Ki kama kajin, ki ɓoye su a ɗaki!" ya ce.

Zahra ta kama kaza ɗaya, sannan wata kaza. Ta ɓoye su a ɗakin kaji. Wata ƙaramar kaza ta gudu, ta ɓoye kanta a ƙarƙashin gado. Zahra ta gan ta, ta kama ta.

Sai ruwa ya fara sauka. Ƙarar ruwan a kan ɗakunan ƙauyen tana da ƙarfi sosai. Zahra ta rufe kunnuwanta da hannayenta.

"Me ya sa kika rufe kunnuwanki?" mahaifiyarta ta ce.

"Ƙarar ruwan tana da yawa a kunnena," Zahra ta ce, tana dariya.

Ruwan ya sauka har zuwa yamma. Dukan ƙauyen ya yi sanyi, kuma yara suka fita suna wasa a cikin ruwa.

Da yamma, Halilu ya tsaya a ƙofar gida. "Mun gode wa Allah," ya ce. "Gobe da safe za mu fara aiki a gona."

Zahra ta buɗe ƙofar ɗakin kaji. Kaji duka suka fito lafiya. "Kun gani?" ta ce wa kajin. "Na ɓoye ku, kuma kun tsira."

Halilu ya yi dariya. "Na gode, Zahra," ya ce. "Ke yarinya ce mai hankali."

Tambayoyi:
Me dukan mutanen ƙauyen suke jira?
Suna jiran ruwan sama.
Me Zahra ta ji da safe?
Ta ji ƙarar iska mai ƙarfi.
Ina Zahra ta ɓoye kajin?
Ta ɓoye su a ɗakin kaji.
Me ya sa Zahra ta rufe kunnuwanta?
Saboda ƙarar ruwan sama tana da yawa a kunnenta.
Yaya kajin suke bayan ruwan?
Kajin duka suna lafiya.

lessons.title: Furannin Lauratu
lessons.summary: In Jos, insects start eating Lauratu's red flowers; she buys a medicine at Mudassir's shop, tries it carefully, and a month later her neighbours praise her garden.
lessons.text:
Lauratu tana zaune a Jos. Tana son furanni sosai. A gaban gidanta akwai furanni iri iri: jajayen furanni, farare, da masu launin shuɗi. Lokacin damina, dukan wurin yakan zama kore.

Jan fure shi ne wanda Lauratu ta fi so. Kowace rana da safe takan ba shi ruwa.

Wata rana da safe, Lauratu ta ga ramuka a jikin jan furenta. Ta duba sosai, sai ta ga ƙananan ƙwari a ƙarƙashin furen. Ƙwarin suna cin furannin, kuma wasu furanni sun fara mutuwa.

"Kai!" ta ce. "Ƙwari suna cin jan furena!"

Ta tafi wani shago kusa da kasuwa. Mai shagon, Mudassir, yana sayar da magungunan furanni.

"Ina so in siya maganin ƙwari," Lauratu ta ce.

Mudassir ya ba ta wata ƙaramar kwalba. "Ki gwada wannan," ya ce. "Ki zuba shi a ruwa, sannan ki zuba ruwan a kan furannin aƙalla sau biyu a mako. Amma kada ki zubar da shi a ƙasa, domin yana da tsada."

"Nawa ne?" ta ce.

"Ɗari biyar," Mudassir ya ce. Lauratu ta siya maganin, ta koma gida.

Da farko, ta gwada maganin a kan jan fure ɗaya kawai. Bayan kwana uku, ƙwarin sun bar furen. Sai ta gwada shi a kan dukan furannin. Aƙalla sau biyu a mako tana zuba maganin. Kuma ta zubar da furannin da ƙwari suka riga suka ci.

Bayan wata ɗaya, furannin sun yi kyau fiye da da. Jajayen furanni sun buɗe, kuma dukan wurin ya sake zama kore.

Mutanen titin suna wucewa suna yaba wa furannin. "Furanninki sun fi na kowa kyau a titin nan!" wata mace ta ce.

Lauratu ta yi dariya. "Ku yaba wa Mudassir," ta ce. "Maganin da na siya a shagonsa ne ya taimaka mini."

Washegari, mutane uku daga titin suka je shagon Mudassir domin su siya maganin ƙwari.

Tambayoyi:
Wane fure ne Lauratu ta fi so?
Jan fure ne ta fi so.
Me yake cin furannin?
Ƙananan ƙwari ne suke cin furannin.
Ina Lauratu ta siya maganin?
Ta siya shi a shagon Mudassir kusa da kasuwa.
Sau nawa take zuba maganin a mako?
Tana zuba shi aƙalla sau biyu a mako.
Me mutanen titin suke yi?
Suna yaba wa furannin Lauratu.

lessons.title: Ruwa ya mamaye ƙauye
lessons.summary: In Kebbi, a flood covers Bashari and Delu's village; police stop them at a bridge, a government boat takes them to a camp, and after ten days they go home to rebuild.
lessons.text:
Bashari da matarsa Delu suna zaune a wani ƙauye a bakin kogi a jihar Kebbi. Suna noman shinkafa a gonarsu.

A tsakiyar damina, an yi ruwan sama kwana uku ba tare da tsayawa ba. Ruwan kogin ya yi yawa, ya fito daga wurinsa. Da dare, ruwa ya mamaye gonaki. Da safe, ya mamaye hanyoyi da gidaje.

Bashari ya auna zurfin ruwan a ɗakinsu da sanda. Zurfinsa ya kai gwiwarsa. Bayan awa ɗaya, zurfin ruwan ya ƙara. "Dole mu tafi yanzu," ya ce wa Delu.

Suka ɗauki 'yan kaya kaɗan, suka kama hanyar gari. Hanyar ta wuce ta kan wata gada. Amma da suka kai gadar, 'yan sanda suka dakatar da su.

"Ba wanda zai wuce," wani ɗan sanda ya ce. "Ruwa ya rufe gadar, kuma ba ta da ƙarfi."

Suka jira awa biyu a bakin gadar. Sai wani jirgin ruwa na gwamnati ya zo, ya ɗauke su zuwa wani sansani. Sansanin yana da nisan kilomita goma daga ƙauyensu.

A sansanin akwai mutane da yawa daga ƙauyuka biyar. Gwamnati tana tallafawa mutanen sansanin da abinci, ruwan sha da magani.

Manema labarai sun zo sansanin. Wani daga cikin manema labaran ya tambayi Bashari, "Ina ƙauyenku yake?"

"Kilomita goma daga nan," Bashari ya ce. "Ruwa ya mamaye dukan gonarmu."

Delu ta ce wa manema labaran, "Mun gode wa gwamnati. Amma muna so mu koma gida."

An dakatar da karatu a makarantun yankin har sai ruwan ya tafi. Bayan kwana goma, ruwan ya fara tafiya. Gwamnati ta ce lokacin komawa gida ya yi.

Komawarsu ba ta yi sauƙi ba. Gidan Bashari da Delu ya lalace, kuma shinkafarsu ta mutu. Amma gwamnati ta ce za ta tallafawa manoman ƙauyen da iri.

Delu ta duba gidanta, ta ce, "Ruwa ya ɗauki kayanmu, amma muna da rai. Za mu sake gina gidanmu."

Tambayoyi:
Me ruwa ya mamaye da dare?
Ruwa ya mamaye gonaki.
Me ya sa 'yan sanda suka dakatar da su a gadar?
Saboda ruwa ya rufe gadar, kuma ba ta da ƙarfi.
Sansanin yana da nisan kilomita nawa daga ƙauyensu?
Yana da nisan kilomita goma.
Wa yake tallafawa mutanen sansanin?
Gwamnati ce take tallafawa mutanen sansanin da abinci, ruwa da magani.
Yaushe suka fara komawa gida?
Bayan kwana goma, da ruwan ya fara tafiya.

lessons.title: Sanyi a Kano
lessons.summary: In the cold harmattan nights of Kano, old Tani coughs and her chest hurts; her granddaughter Mardiyya dresses her warmly, takes her to the doctor and cooks for her until she is well.
lessons.text:
Mardiyya tana zaune da kakarta Tani a cikin birnin Kano. Yanzu lokacin sanyi ne. Iska mai sanyi tana kawo ƙura daga arewa.

Kwanakin wannan lokaci gajeru ne: rana tana faɗuwa da wuri. Amma tsahon dare yana da yawa, kuma dare yana da sanyi sosai.

Wata rana da dare, Tani ta fara tari. Ta dinga tari har tsakiyar dare. "Ƙirjina yana ciwo," ta ce wa Mardiyya.

Mardiyya ta tashi. Ta kawo wa kakarta tufafi masu nauyi, ta sa mata su. "Ki sa waɗannan tufafin," ta ce. "Sanyi ne ya kawo miki wannan tari."

Da safe, Mardiyya ta kai Tani wurin likita. Likitan ya saurari ƙirjinta. "Sanyi ne ya shiga ƙirjinki," ya ce.

Ya ba ta ƙwayoyin magani da wani mai. "Ki sha ƙwaya ɗaya da safe, ɗaya da dare," ya ce. "Kuma ki dinga shafa wannan mai a ƙirjinki kafin kwanciya. Kada ki fita da dare ba tare da tufafi masu nauyi ba."

Da suka koma gida, Mardiyya ta dafa wa kakarta ruwan zafi. Ta kuma dafa mata abinci mai zafi. "Abinci mai zafi yana da kyau a lokacin sanyi," ta ce.

Da dare, kafin kwanciya, Mardiyya ta shafa man a ƙirjin kakarta. Tani ta sha ƙwayar maganinta, sannan ta kwanta.

Saboda tsahon daren, Tani ba ta yi barci da wuri ba. Ta dinga ba Mardiyya labari. "Tunawa da lokacin da nake yarinya yana sa ni farin ciki," ta ce. "A lokacin, sanyi ya fi na yanzu. Ina tunawa da yadda muke zama a gaban wuta har tsakiyar dare."

"Ki kwanta yanzu," Mardiyya ta ce. "Gajeren lokaci ne ya rage kafin safe."

Kowace rana Mardiyya tana dafa abinci mai zafi, kuma kowane dare tana shafa man kafin kwanciya. Bayan kwana biyar, tarin Tani ya tafi.

"Na gode, Mardiyya," Tani ta ce. "Ke ce likitata."

Tambayoyi:
Yaya kwanakin lokacin sanyi suke?
Kwanakin gajeru ne, kuma tsahon dare yana da yawa.
Me Tani ta ce da dare?
Ta ce, "Ƙirjina yana ciwo."
Me likitan ya ba Tani?
Ya ba ta ƙwayoyin magani da wani mai.
Me Mardiyya ta dafa wa kakarta?
Ta dafa mata ruwan zafi da abinci mai zafi.
Yaushe Mardiyya take shafa mai a ƙirjin kakarta?
Tana shafa shi kafin kwanciya.

lessons.title: Ƙwararru a Baga
lessons.summary: Experts from Maiduguri visit Baga to study Lake Chad; the tall old fisherman Shettima shows them where the water was twenty years ago, and they compare old and new photographs.
lessons.text:
Shettima mutum ne mai tsayi, mai shekara 60. Yana kamun kifi a Baga, a bakin tafkin Chadi, tun yana yaro.

Wata rana, wasu ƙwararru daga jami'ar Maiduguri suka zo su ziyarci Baga. Shugabansu shi ne Kamaluddeen. Ƙwararrun suna nazarin ruwan tafkin.

Kamaluddeen ya ce wa Shettima, "Mun zo ne mu ziyarci wuraren da ruwan tafkin yake a da."

Shettima ya kai su wani babban fili. "Shekara ashirin da suka wuce, ruwa yana nan," ya ce. "Tsayin ruwan ya kai ƙirjina. Yanzu ruwan yana nesa. Dole mu yi tafiyar kilomita da yawa kafin mu kai shi."

Kamaluddeen ya buɗe wani babban kundi. A cikin kundin akwai hotunan tafkin na shekaru da yawa. Ya nuna wa Shettima wani hoto. "Wannan hoton wurin nan ne, shekara ashirin da suka wuce," ya ce. Sai ya nuna wani sabon hoto. "Ka kwatanta hotunan biyu."

Shettima ya kwatanta su. "Bambancin yana da yawa," ya ce. "A da, wurin nan duka ruwa ne. Yanzu, ƙasa ce kawai."

"Haka ne," Kamaluddeen ya ce. "Mu ƙwararru mun kwatanta girman tafkin a yau da na da. Bambancin yana da girma ƙwarai. Ruwan ya yi nesa da garuruwa da yawa."

"Tuni na san haka," Shettima ya ce. "Tun da daɗewa kifi ya yi ƙaranci. Matasa da yawa sun bar garin."

Ƙwararrun suka auna tsayin ruwan a wurare da yawa. Suka rubuta komai a cikin kundin.

Kafin su tafi, Kamaluddeen ya ce, "Za mu kai rahotonmu ga gwamnati. Ba da daɗewa ba za a fara wani shiri domin taimakon mutanen Baga."

Shettima ya ce, "Allah ya sa. Tuni muna jiran taimako."

Tambayoyi:
Daga ina ƙwararrun suka zo?
Sun zo daga jami'ar Maiduguri.
Me ya sa suka ziyarci Baga?
Saboda suna nazarin ruwan tafkin Chadi.
Me ke cikin kundin Kamaluddeen?
Akwai hotunan tafkin na shekaru da yawa a ciki.
Ina ruwan tafkin yake yanzu?
Yanzu ruwan yana nesa.
Me Shettima ya ce bayan ya kwatanta hotunan?
Ya ce bambancin yana da yawa.

lessons.title: Bishiyoyin Daura
lessons.summary: Daura's local government launches a tree-planting plan; Malam Jafaru's pupils clear the rubbish in front of their mosque, each plants a tree, and three months later the chairman praises them.
lessons.text:
Garin Daura yana kusa da hamada. Kowace shekara iska mai zafi tana kawo ƙasa cikin gari. Saboda haka, gudanarwar ƙaramar hukumar Daura ta ƙaddamar da wani shiri na dasa bishiyoyi.

Shugaban ƙaramar hukumar ya ƙaddamar da shirin a gaban babban masallacin garin. "Kowanne sashe na garin zai dasa bishiyoyi ɗari," ya ce.

Malam Jafaru malami ne a wata makaranta a sashen gabas na garin. Ya ce wa ɗalibansa, "Gobe za mu je masallacin sashenmu. Wurin yana da shara da yawa. Kafin mu dasa bishiyoyi, dole mu kawar da sharar."

Washegari ɗalibai talatin suka zo. Rumasa'u ce ta farko. Suka kawar da shara a gaban masallacin, suka kai ta wurin da ake zuba shara.

Sai Malam Jafaru ya ba kowanne ɗalibi ƙaramar bishiya ɗaya. "Wannan bishiyar taka ce," ya ce wa kowanne. "Wajibi ne ka ba ta ruwa kowace rana har zuwa damina."

Rumasa'u ta dasa bishiyarta kusa da ƙofar masallacin. Liman ya fito daga masallacin, ya ƙarfafa yaran. "Kun yi aiki mai kyau," ya ce. "Bishiya tana hana iska ɗaukar ƙasarmu. Wajibi ne mu kula da ƙasarmu."

Kowace rana bayan makaranta, Rumasa'u takan kai ruwa ga bishiyarta. Malam Jafaru kuma yakan ƙarfafa ɗalibansa: "Kada ku manta da bishiyoyinku!"

Bayan wata uku, shugaban ƙaramar hukuma ya zo duba aikin. Ya ga bishiyoyin sashen gabas sun yi tsawo, kuma babu shara a gaban masallacin. Ya ƙarfafa ɗaliban, ya ba makarantarsu kyauta.

"Gudanarwarmu tana alfahari da ku," ya ce. "Sashenku ya fi kowanne sashe kyau a garin nan."

Rumasa'u ta koma gida tana murna. Ta ce wa mahaifiyarta, "Ina alfahari da bishiyata. Ita ce mafi tsawo a gaban masallaci."

Tambayoyi:
Me gudanarwar ƙaramar hukumar Daura ta ƙaddamar?
Ta ƙaddamar da shirin dasa bishiyoyi.
Bishiyoyi nawa kowanne sashe zai dasa?
Kowanne sashe zai dasa bishiyoyi ɗari.
Me ɗaliban suka yi kafin su dasa bishiyoyi?
Sun kawar da shara a gaban masallacin.
Me yake wajibi ga kowanne ɗalibi?
Wajibi ne ya ba bishiyarsa ruwa kowace rana.
Me shugaban ƙaramar hukuma ya ce?
Ya ce, "Gudanarwarmu tana alfahari da ku."

lessons.title: Ruwan da ya shahara
lessons.summary: Khalid and his sister Barira ride horses with the guide Ma'aruf across a wide field to a famous waterfall near Kafanchan, by a secret path, and Ma'aruf finds Khalid's lost cap.
lessons.text:
Khalid da 'yar uwarsa Barira sun zo daga Kaduna domin ganin wani shahararren wurin ruwa kusa da Kafanchan. A wurin, ruwa yana faɗowa daga kan wani babban dutse. Wurin ya shahara a dukan Najeriya, kuma mutane da yawa suna zuwa ganinsa.

A ƙauyen, sun haɗu da wani jagora mai suna Ma'aruf. Ma'aruf yana da dawaki uku. "Hanyar tana da nisa," ya ce. "Za mu hau dawaki. Ku biyo ni."

Barira ta hau wani farin doki, Khalid kuma ya hau wani jan doki. Suka biyo jagoran. Suka wuce wani babban fage. A tsakiyar fagen, Barira ta ga shanu suna cin abinci.

Bayan fagen, hanyar ta shiga daji. Ma'aruf ya tsaya a gefen wani ƙaramin kogi. "Ku saurara," ya ce. "Kun ji ƙarar ruwan?"

"Mun ji," Khalid ya ce.

"Akwai wata hanya ta asiri a nan," Ma'aruf ya ce. "Ba kowa ne ya san ta ba. Ita ce hanya mafi kusa."

"Hanyar asiri?" Khalid ya ce yana dariya. "To, za mu biyo ka."

Suka bi hanyar asirin a gefen kogin. Ba da daɗewa ba suka isa wurin. Ruwa yana faɗowa daga kan dutse mai tsawo. Kewaye da ruwan akwai duwatsu da bishiyoyi koraye.

Barira ta ce, "Yanzu na gane dalilin da ya sa wannan wuri ya shahara."

Suka sauka daga kan dawakinsu, suka zauna a gefen ruwan. Sannan suka yi yawo a kewayen wurin.

Amma da za su tafi, Khalid ya nemi hularsa, bai gan ta ba. Ma'aruf ya duba kewaye. Sai ya same ta a kan wani dutse a gefen ruwan. "Ga hularka," ya ce. "Na same ta."

Da suka koma ƙauye, Khalid ya ba Ma'aruf kuɗi. "Kai ne jagora mafi kyau," ya ce. "Za mu dawo, kuma za mu sake biyo hanyar asirinka."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Khalid da Barira suka zo daga Kaduna?
Sun zo domin ganin wani shahararren wurin ruwa.
Wane ne jagoransu?
Jagoransu shi ne Ma'aruf.
Me Barira ta gani a tsakiyar fagen?
Ta ga shanu suna cin abinci.
Me ke kewaye da ruwan?
Akwai duwatsu da bishiyoyi kewaye da ruwan.
Ina Ma'aruf ya ga hular Khalid?
Ya same ta a kan wani dutse a gefen ruwan.

lessons.title: Kogin Challawa
lessons.summary: Fishermen tell Nana of Kano's environment agency that fish are dying in the Challawa river; she tests the water, the head of a cloth factory first denies the blame, then borrows from a bank to clean the river.
lessons.text:
Nana ma'aikaciya ce a hukumar kula da muhalli ta jihar Kano. Ofishinta yana kusa da kogin Challawa.

Wata rana wasu masunta suka zo ofishinta. "Kifi yana mutuwa a kogin," suka ce. "Kuma ruwan ya canza launi."

Nana ta je bakin kogin. Ta ɗauki ruwa a kwalba biyu, ta kai su ofis domin a gwada ingancinsu. Sakamakon ya nuna cewa ingancin ruwan ba shi da kyau ko kaɗan.

Kusa da kogin akwai wata babbar masana'antar tufafi. Nana ta je ofishin shugaban masana'antar, Hamid.

Hamid ya musa da farko. "Masana'antarmu ba ta zubar da komai a kogin," ya ce.

Nana ta nuna masa sakamakon. "Haƙiƙa launin ruwan nan daga masana'antarka ne," ta ce. "Mun gwada ruwan kafin masana'antar, kuma ingancinsa yana da kyau. Bayan masana'antar, ba shi da kyau."

Hamid ya duba sakamakon, ya daina musa. "Haƙiƙa ba mu sani ba," ya ce. "Masana'antarmu ta bunƙasa sosai a shekarun nan. Muna da ma'aikata ɗari biyar. Ba ma so mu lalata kogin."

"Hulɗarmu da mutanen garin tana da kyau," ya ce. "Ina so hulɗar nan ta ci gaba. Me za mu yi?"

Nana ta ce, "Ku sayi injin da yake tsabtace ruwa. Kuma ku daidaita hanyar ruwan masana'antar, kada ta kai kogi kai tsaye."

Hamid ya je banki. Bankin ya ba shi kuɗi domin sayen injin. Ma'aikatansa suka daidaita hanyar ruwa, suka sa injin a ciki.

Bayan wata uku, Nana ta sake gwada ingancin ruwan kogin. Ingancinsa ya yi kyau. "Kun maida kogin kamar yadda yake a da," ta ce wa Hamid.

Masunta kuma suka maida hankalinsu ga kamun kifi. Kasuwancinsu ya sake bunƙasa. Hamid ya ce, "Bashin banki yana da nauyi, amma kogi mai tsabta ya fi kuɗi."

Tambayoyi:
Ina ofishin Nana yake?
Ofishinta yana kusa da kogin Challawa.
Me masunta suka ce?
Sun ce kifi yana mutuwa a kogin.
Me Hamid ya yi da farko?
Ya musa, ya ce masana'antarsa ba ta zubar da komai a kogin.
Daga ina Hamid ya sami kuɗin sayen injin?
Ya sami kuɗin daga banki.
Yaya ingancin ruwan yake bayan wata uku?
Ingancinsa ya yi kyau.

lessons.title: Wasan karta a Sokoto
lessons.summary: In the Sokoto heat, old men play cards under a tree every afternoon; while Mainasara is away, the young Sadisu takes his place and helps them, and when Mainasara returns he makes room for him.
lessons.text:
A lokacin zafi a Sokoto, rana tana da zafi sosai. Bayan cin abinci da rana, wasu tsofaffi sukan zauna a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya a gefen kasuwa. A can sukan yi wasan karta har yamma.

Tsofaffin su huɗu ne. Mainasara ne ya fi kowa iya wasan karta. Amma wata rana ya yi tafiya zuwa Maradi wurin 'yarsa. Gurbinsa a wurin wasan ya zama babu kowa.

Wani saurayi mai suna Sadisu ya zo. "Ina so in maye gurbin Mainasara," ya ce.

Sa'idu, ɗaya daga cikin tsofaffin, ya yi dariya. "Kai saurayi ne. Kana iya wasan karta?"

"Kakana ya koya mini," saurayin ya ce.

"To, zauna." Sadisu ya zauna a gurbin Mainasara. Sa'idu ya ɗora kartar a kan tabarma. "Wace karta za ka ɗauka?" ya ce.

Sadisu ya ɗauki karta ɗaya. Sa'idu ya ce, "Wace ce?" Sadisu ya nuna musu. Sai suka fara wasa.

Sadisu ya ci wasa na farko. Tsofaffin suka yi mamaki. "Haka kakanka yake yi!" Sa'idu ya ce.

Kowace rana Sadisu yakan zo da ruwan sanyi gami da goro. Yakan taya tsofaffin ɗaukar tabarma da kujeru. Yakan ɗora tabarmar a kan kansa, ya kai ta gida.

Da zarar rana ta fara faɗuwa, tsofaffin sukan daina wasan, su tafi masallaci. Sadisu kuma yakan taya su ɗaukar kayansu.

Bayan mako biyu, Mainasara ya dawo. Da zarar ya isa, ya tafi wurin bishiyar. "Wa ya maye gurbina?" ya ce.

"Wannan saurayin," Sa'idu ya ce. "Ya taya mu da yawa, kuma ya iya karta."

Mainasara ya kalli Sadisu. "Kada ka tafi," ya ce. "Za mu kawo wata kujera. Akwai gurbi ga kowa."

Sadisu ya yi murna. Da zarar ya isa gida, ya faɗa wa kakansa.

Tambayoyi:
Ina tsofaffin sukan yi wasan karta?
Sukan yi shi a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya a gefen kasuwa.
Ina Mainasara ya tafi?
Ya tafi Maradi wurin 'yarsa.
Wa ya maye gurbin Mainasara?
Wani saurayi mai suna Sadisu ne ya maye gurbinsa.
Me Sadisu yakan kawo kowace rana?
Yakan kawo ruwan sanyi gami da goro.
Me tsofaffin sukan yi da zarar rana ta fara faɗuwa?
Sukan daina wasan, su tafi masallaci.

lessons.title: Zaɓen manoma
lessons.summary: Before the rains, a village near Zaria elects a new head of its farmers' association after Malam Abba receives a traditional title; young Hureira wins the votes, and the older Mamuda congratulates her.
lessons.text:
Malam Abba ya yi shekara goma a matsayin shugaban ƙungiyar manoma ta wani ƙauye kusa da Zaria. A wannan shekara Sarkin Zazzau ya ba shi sarautar Sarkin Noma. Saboda sabuwar sarautarsa, ya bar shugabancin ƙungiyar.

Kafin damina, ƙungiyar ta shirya zaɓen sabon shugaba. Mutum biyu ne suka nemi shugabancin: Hureira da Mamuda.

Hureira budurwa ce. Ta gama karatun noma a Zaria, kuma ta ci jarabawarta ta ƙarshe da kyau. Ta ce, "Jarabawa ta koya mini abubuwa da yawa game da ƙasa da ruwa."

Mamuda kuma tsoho ne. Ya yi shekara arba'in yana noma. Halayyarsa tana da kyau, kuma mutane suna girmama shi saboda mutuncinsa.

Ranar zaɓe, manoma da yawa suka zo domin halartar taron. Malam Abba ya gode musu saboda halartarsu.

Mamuda ya fara magana. "Muna da ƙalubale da yawa," ya ce. "Ƙalubale na farko shi ne fashin shanu. 'Yan fashi suna zuwa da dare, su ɗauki shanunmu. Zan yi aiki tare da 'yan sanda domin a kawar da fashi."

Sai Hureira ta tashi. "Ina da mafarki," ta ce. "A mafarkina, kowane manomi yana da ruwa a lokacin rani, da iri mai kyau. Za mu gina rijiya, kuma za mu koyi sababbin hanyoyin noma."

Manoma suka saurari dukansu biyu. Sannan suka jefa ƙuri'unsu. Malam Abba ya ƙirga ƙuri'u. Hureira ta sami ƙuri'u 40, Mamuda kuma ya sami ƙuri'u 35.

Mamuda ya tashi, ya je wurin Hureira. "Ina taya ki murna," ya ce. "Ke ce shugabarmu yanzu."

"Na gode," Hureira ta ce. "Kai mutum ne mai mutunci. Ina so ka taimaka mini da ƙalubalen fashi."

"Zan taimaka," Mamuda ya ce. Mutane suka yaba wa halayyarsa.

Tambayoyi:
Wace sarauta Sarkin Zazzau ya ba Malam Abba?
Ya ba shi sarautar Sarkin Noma.
Me Hureira ta yi a Zaria?
Ta gama karatun noma, kuma ta ci jarabawarta ta ƙarshe.
Me ya sa mutane suke girmama Mamuda?
Saboda mutuncinsa da halayyarsa mai kyau.
Wane ƙalubale ne Mamuda ya faɗa da farko?
Ya faɗi fashin shanu.
Ƙuri'u nawa Hureira ta samu?
Ta sami ƙuri'u 40.
